trjk7tqg.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Bulbs Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 210 cm
trjk7tqg.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Bulbs Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 210 cm
trjk7tqg.sourceDescription: This stunning Artificial Christmas Tree is designed to transform your living space into a winter wonderland. With a modern cone-shaped style, it's the perfect focal point for holiday gatherings and seasonal decorations. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, its lifelike tips offer the realism of a natural tree, ensuring a charming holiday ambiance without the hassle of upkeep. Its classic green hue and clean lines provide a contemporary touch, seamlessly blending into various decors, whether in a cozy living room or an expansive hall. Materials: Crafted with premium PVC, polyethylene, and a sturdy metal base, this Artificial Christmas Tree offers a superior realistic look combined with long-lasting durability. The blend of materials provides an authentic texture and visual appeal while ensuring robust support. Included Components: Equipped with flexible LED strip lights in warm white, providing versatile and ambient lighting options. The included USB plug allows for easy connectivity without a traditional power adapter. The black steel stand offers stability and is easy to set up. Features /Function /Design: Enjoy the modern and sleek design characterized by simplicity and minimal ornamentation, adding a touch of elegance to your interior décor. The LED lights have eight different flash modes to customize your desired ambiance. Recommended Uses: This tree is suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, making it a versatile option for creating festive vibes in various settings such as living rooms, entryways, or patios. Care &Maintenance: Assemble as per the manufacturer's instructions. Regularly check and secure connections for optimal safety. No special maintenance required, ensuring a hassle-free experience during the holiday season. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and metal and plastic Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 58 cm Stand size: 50 cm Lifelike Tips Number of PE tips: 189 Number of PVC tips: 415 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
